source.title: European Rubik's Cube Championship 2012 on October 12-14, 2012 in Wroclaw, Poland
source.content: The [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2012](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2012) will take place on October 12-14, 2012 in Wroclaw, Poland. Check out the [Euro 2012 website](http://www.speedcubing.com/events/euro2012) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2012 年欧洲魔方锦标赛将于 10 月 12–14 日在波兰弗罗茨瓦夫举行
translation.content: [2012 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2012)将于 2012 年 10 月 12–14 日在波兰弗罗茨瓦夫举行。更多信息及报名请见 [Euro 2012 网站](http://www.speedcubing.com/events/euro2012)。
